summary: Rejected for pull-request review. The portfolio is strong on role legibility, emerging-work framing, collective credit, and public-safe evidence boundaries, but the 2.5 certification machinery still admits incomplete browser coverage, uncontained evidence paths, and arbitrary human/deployment evidence. Acceptance would therefore overstate what the automated record proves. The five external human gates remain open, and this judgment is not production approval.
